note: Chrome CPU-throttle proxy for an iPhone XS Max; GPU work is not throttled. The host carried 28-46% unrelated load for the whole session (accepted baseline windows ran at 21-28%), so absolute frame times are not comparable with docs/testing/hmh-perf-crowd-baseline.json. The A/B below alternates the base and step-1 builds under the same conditions.

initialJs.note: npm run build, entry + shared chunks + vendor; the pool itself is a lazy chunk (enemy-display-pool-*.js) fetched beside app.init

displayPool.note: Census, mobile, virtual clock. Old code rebuilt every live display (about 100-128) on each insert/retire and built one display per corpse.

abTiming.order: pairs alternate which build runs first; --retries=0; same host window

profileComparison.note: ms and % of busy main-thread time in one 20 s window. Baseline profiles are the recorded 1.8.1 ones, resolved against a byte-identical rebuild of the base (1,047,471 B with map comments).

suite.note: Chrome CPU-throttle proxy for an iPhone XS Max; GPU work is not throttled. Not physical-device evidence.
suite.scenario: evidenceSafe=1&endurancePressurePilot=1 (128 endurance-band enemies at tick 0, invulnerable auto-firing hero, no respawns), parent-hosted Free session
